scope: Actual page modules with synthetic DOM/HTTP/auth/store, not real API32/browser/PG/axe

results.case: Personal startup reads only, leaves profile unselected and shows actual observed counts
Explicit measurement records one fixed-unit payload without deriving lean mass
Lost measurement ACK remains one write until an explicit same-key readback
Same-document replacement synchronously clears visible health and cannot be undone by a late write
OWNER after reload can discover and withdraw own metadata without profiles or source lookups
A stale withdrawal sends only the event seen, then requires readback and a new explicit action
Consent requires explicit categories/profile/dates/confirmation and sends observed CAS
Changing consent scope clears confirmation and cannot auto-save on form changes
Professional startup is readonly and a shared projection is requested only explicitly
A denied professional re-read clears native and recipient health rather than retaining cached data
Revoking a shared source before a new read clears the prior projection and shows error
Pagehide discards health, dates, operation drafts and own metadata without touching unidentified bytes
Double submit is fenced before any verification await and sends a single measurement
A missing readback offers only an explicit retry of the original measurement key and body
An edit CAS conflict is read back for comparison and requires a fresh explicit correction
A synchronous Storage failure event clears the mounted health DOM before another user interaction
